title: Melody Valkyrie: Huntress of Norp
synopsis: Melody Valkyrie, the Last Daughter of Lobos, roams the galaxy hunting criminals while chasing the one mystery that defines her life: the identity of The Redacted, the apocalyptic force that annihilated her homeworld. Her search brings her to the frozen desert moon of Norp, where a notorious Malcian war-beast named Gigas crash-lands after a brutal space duel.

title: Melody Valkyrie: Harbinger of Vengeance
synopsis: From a hidden stronghold, Melody Valkyrie, Last Daughter of Lobos and intra/outra-galactic bounty hunter, monitors the “Great Pulse,” the universal heartbeat that warns her of rising evil. When she senses a jarring disturbance, she realizes the nightmare at the heart of a black hole, The Redacted, is stirring again. To stop its return, Melody needs answers, and all leads point to Bazaar, a tidally locked world of endless night where anything can be bought if the price is high enough.

title: Melody Valkyrie: Harvestman of Palus
synopsis: Melody Valkyrie, Last Daughter of Lobos and unstoppable intra/outra-galactic bounty hunter, travels to the swamp world of Palus, a world covered almost entirely by shallow, monster-infested water. Her goal is simple but extremely dangerous: locate the reclusive arachnoid master-craftsman known only as Harvestman and obtain a legendary hull weave capable of shielding her living starship, Lo, from the murderous radiation of a dark pulsar.

title: The Rime of Aurora Roe
synopsis: Aurora Roe is the solitary warden of Fiddler’s Green, a hidden, primeval valley untouched by time and guarded in reverent balance with nature. Her quiet guardianship ends when a malignant star, Wormwood, streaks across the twin-sunned sky and crashes into the forest, poisoning the land and heralding an ancient prophecy of war.

title: Aurora Roe: Harvest Prime
synopsis: After a millennium of guarding Fiddler’s Green, Aurora Roe is abruptly dismissed by the same unseen powers that appointed her. Cast out of paradise under the excuse of “budget cuts,” she summons Yggdrasil, a living, interstellar carriage, and departs with only a navigator-dove named Lux. She asks to be taken “where I am most needed,” and arrives on Harvest Prime, an agrarian world ruled by the planet-spanning corporation Lovehate Ltd. beneath the same twin suns, White and Red.

title: Diminishing Returns
synopsis: Diminishing Returns is a post-apocalyptic, time-travel novella written in a text-adventure transcript style, where the reader is both the player and the protagonist. You awaken in a failing stasis pod deep underground with no memory. The world is broken, systems are corrupted, and survival is immediate and urgent. Through puzzle-solving and observation, you escape into a massive facility filled with abandoned pods and hints of catastrophe.
